description: This file defines a WebhookNotification class for sending webhook notifications within the Superset reporting system, including methods for constructing payloads, handling files, and sending HTTP requests with error handling and feature flag checks.

classes.name: WebhookNotification
classes.description: A class for sending webhook notifications, extending BaseNotification, with methods to construct payloads, retrieve webhook URL, handle files, and send HTTP requests with retries and error handling.

methods.name: _get_webhook_url
methods.description: Retrieves the webhook URL from the recipient configuration JSON, raising an exception if not found or invalid.

methods.name: _get_req_payload
methods.description: Constructs the payload dictionary for the webhook request, including header data and content details.

methods.name: _get_files
methods.description: Collects files (CSV, PDF, screenshots) to be sent with the webhook request.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the webhook notification via HTTP POST, with feature flag check, HTTPS enforcement, retries on failure, and error handling based on response status.
